reason: If the school sets it as homework during the pilot, fine, my child will do it. But we already pay a tuition teacher who sits with my child in person, and I'm not paying extra to keep another screen going once the free pilot ends.
objection: More screen time is the last thing my child needs, and an app can't explain a concept the way a teacher sitting next to them can. Our tuition teacher already covers the gaps.
would_change_my_mind: If the end-of-term re-test showed clear gains our tuition teacher hadn't managed, and the class teacher kept using it as part of the school's own homework, so it wasn't something extra I had to push at home.
